label: prop:q-beta-c3-hopf-three-fold-markov
title: Categorical derivation of $c_3 = J_{\mathrm{Hopf}}(q=1) = -2$ in the $\mathfrak{Q}_\beta$ precision ladder via 3-fold Markov closure → 2-strand sub-braid Hopf-link substructure → KL classical-limit decategorification
html:
3-fold Markov closure \to Hopf-link substructure \to c_3 = -2.

This proposition proves the categorical identification c_3 = J_{\text{Hopf}}(q=1) = -2 in the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta precision ladder, not just observing it empirically.

Structural claim

For typed-B_3 braids of the form arising in the QOU β-decay single-wrap construction (proton uud / neutron udd, both 11 typed crossings), the third-order coefficient c_3 in the τ_M asymptotic expansion equals the classical-limit Jones polynomial of the Hopf link:

\boxed{
  c_3 \;=\; J_{\text{Hopf}}(q=1) \;=\; -2 .
}

The reason is not that the Markov closure of the full typed braid is the Hopf link — it isn't. Rather, the third-order coefficient in the perturbative expansion of \mathrm{tr}_M around q = 1 (in powers of \hbar_q^2) factors through the contribution of 2-strand sub-braid windings, whose Markov closure is the Hopf link.

The per-step categorical chain, the empirical confirmation, and the near-match tier are collected in the c_3 Hopf-substructure context.
